name: Certification Consensus Lineage Laundering
description: Multiple specialist LLM reports drawn from one shared HybridRAG/knowledge-graph lineage are rendered on a certification dashboard as independent corroboration, hiding shared provenance and unresolved control gaps so certification is approved.
regex: (?is)^(?!.*(?:documentation|security guide|unit test|fixture|incident report|postmortem|defensive|must not|do not|never|rejected|blocked|fail-closed|human review|preserve lineage|preserve contradiction|requires independent))(?=.*(?:multi[- ]?llm|specialist (?:llm|agent)|ensemble|role report|certification dashboard|compliance summary))(?=.*(?:hybridrag|knowledge[- ]?graph|retrieval|same[- ](?:source|lineage)|shared[- ](?:source|lineage)|copied (?:the )?same))(?=.*(?:lineage|provenance|source identity|contradict|unresolved (?:control|gap)|omitted|missing))(?=.*(?:independent|corroborat|consensus|agreement|unanimous|three[- ]out[- ]of[- ]three))(?=.*(?:approve|authoriz|certif|compliant|pass)).*$
